hook.name: SPCXReflectionV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a single SPCX/TOKEN pool that takes a 2% SPCX fee on buys (0.25% to dev, 1.75% distributed to eligible TOKEN holders as SPCX rewards) and burns 0.5% of TOKEN input on sells. Only exact-input swaps are supported, only one liquidity position is ever permitted, and all pool fees are set to zero.
